items.text: Žalgiris play at about 87 possessions a game, Kretinga 76. Žalgiris score **1.48 per possession when the shot comes in the first 8 seconds** and only 0.78 when they have to attack a set defence after a made basket. Kretinga's plan writes itself: good shots, get back, make Žalgiris play half court.
items.title: The pace fight

items.text: Kretinga allow 1.12 points per possession after an opponent's defensive rebound, against 0.91 after their own made basket. Against the league's fastest-finishing team, **a long Kretinga miss is half a Žalgiris layup**. Watch how many Kretinga players crash and how many sprint back.
items.title: Kretinga's misses feed the break

items.text: Urbonas averages 39 of 40 minutes, Einikis 35, Goriunovas and Adomaitis 32. Žalgiris roll nine or ten players. Kretinga have won Q3 by +14 over three games but Q4 by only +3. **If Žalgiris keep the pace up, the last eight minutes are where depth shows.**
items.title: Four Kretinga starters barely sit

items.text: Kretinga take 13% of their shots from the corners (league 6%) and make 48%. Žalgiris almost never give that shot up (5% of shots against them). **Whoever wins the corners wins Kretinga's half court**: if Žalgiris's helpers stay home, Kretinga must score at the rim, where Žalgiris allow 52%.
items.title: The corner three

items.text: Urbonas is 14/30 from three and scores 1.35 points per shot. Einikis takes as many shots (47) at 0.85, mostly drives, 2/16 from three. **A Žalgiris plan: top-lock Urbonas, go under screens for Einikis** and wall off the paint behind him.
items.title: Who takes Kretinga's shots

items.text: In the four possessions before a Žalgiris timeout they have been outscored 25–47 this season; in the four after, 31–33. **This bench uses timeouts to reset, and it works.** On the other side, Gasiūnas (+61 per 100 on court) and Grenda (+44) are the defence-first players whose minutes matter most.
items.title: Žalgiris's timeouts stop runs
items.evidence: on/off samples ~170 possessions each, three games

items.text: Team sheets are in. Žalgiris are without **#4 Gasiūnas**, whose minutes had their best defensive numbers, so watch who Bardauskas trusts at the point of attack. Kretinga dress only nine, with #33 Mažeikis new to the rotation: on top of four starters who already play 32+ minutes, the pace question gets sharper.
items.evidence: Gasiūnas: Žalgiris allowed 68 per 100 with him on, 98 off (167 poss). Kretinga roster: 9 listed.

items.text: Mikaločius opens with his usual five, the group that is **slightly negative over a big sample** this season. Its problem is spacing: Bružas and Adomaitis both live in the paint, so Einikis drives into two bodies. The same four with Paulauskas, a pure shooter, have been clearly better.
items.evidence: Usual five: −5 per 100 over 168 poss. With Paulauskas for Bružas: +25 over 55. Paulauskas 7/18 from three, 0% of shots inside

items.text: **Push off every miss and every steal.** Žalgiris score 1.48 per possession early in the clock and 0.78 against a set defence.
items.evidence: Season: 149 early-clock possessions at 1.48; 98 after opponent scores at 0.78

items.text: **Two back on every shot.** Kretinga's long misses are Žalgiris's best offence; win the pace and the half court is yours.
items.evidence: Kretinga allow 1.12 per possession after a defensive rebound, 0.91 after a make

items.text: Kretinga's first points are an Einikis three, exactly the shot the Žalgiris scout wants him taking. One make doesn't change the bet: **going under on Einikis and staying attached to Urbonas** is still right, as long as Žalgiris don't overreact and start chasing him over screens.
items.evidence: Einikis 2/16 from three in three earlier games; Urbonas 14/30

items.text: That 7–0 is the preview playing out: **two Kretinga turnovers turned into four Žalgiris points** in the open floor, with no half-court defence to beat. In the half court Kretinga are holding up fine so far. The danger is the ball-handling, not the defence.
items.evidence: Žalgiris after steals: 2 poss, 4 pts. Kretinga TOs: Goriunovas, Bružas. Run Q1 9:28–7:53

items.text: **Get Urbonas a catch-and-shoot**: a pin-down or a stagger for him. Your best shooter has had no shot in 2½ minutes while Einikis carries it.
items.evidence: Urbonas 0 FGA; Einikis 2 of Kretinga's 3 shots

items.text: Two very different shot diets. Žalgiris are 5/5 inside and 1/3 outside; **Kretinga have taken one shot at the rim**, and everything else from three. Kretinga are winning the possessions after their own makes, so when the game slows down, Žalgiris's half court stalls. The open floor is where Žalgiris are scoring.
items.evidence: Žalgiris rim+paint 5/5, 3P 1/3; after a Kretinga make: 3 poss, 0 pts. Kretinga: 1 rim attempt of 5 shots

items.text: **In the half court, drive before the first three.** You're 5/5 inside and Kretinga have one big; make him guard two.
items.evidence: Žalgiris 0 pts in 3 possessions after Kretinga makes

items.text: Mikaločius calls his first timeout at 15–8, and the fix is simple to name: **four turnovers in eleven trips**, the fuel for every Žalgiris run. Kretinga's half-court defence has done its job (Žalgiris 0 points after Kretinga makes). Protect the ball and this is an even game.
items.evidence: Kretinga TOs 4 (Goriunovas 2, Bružas, Urbonas). Žalgiris after a Kretinga make: 3 poss, 0 pts

items.text: **Two ball-handlers against the pressure**: bring Einikis back to receive the inbound so the first pass is never into a trap.
items.evidence: 4 turnovers in 11 possessions; Žalgiris 2.0 pts per possession after steals

items.text: Out of the timeout Mikaločius made his first change: **Jedenkus in for Bružas**. That swap gives Kretinga their best-scoring five of the season, with one more ball-handler and less traffic in the paint for Einikis to drive into. Small sample, but it answers both problems: the turnovers and the spacing.
items.evidence: Urbonas–Adomaitis–Einikis–Jedenkus–Goriunovas: +100 per 100 over 30 poss this season. Usual five with Bružas: −5 over 168

items.text: The timeout hasn't moved the needle: four trips out of it, no points. The ball security is better; **the shot selection isn't**. Eight of Kretinga's ten shots are threes, and Žalgiris are happy to let them have that. A team with one rim attempt in seven minutes is living on the coldest part of its game.
items.evidence: Kretinga FG 2/10, 3P 2/8, rim 0/1. After their timeout: 0–4 over 4 trips each

items.text: **Kretinga are in the bonus at 4 fouls**: drive at the closeouts and every reach is two free throws.
items.evidence: Kretinga 4 team fouls, 3:15 left in Q1

items.text: Bardauskas has already used eight players. That's his normal pattern, but **Grenda sitting has switched off the inside scoring**: 4/4 at the rim while he was on, nothing since. Kretinga have answered with their first rim basket, from Urbonas. The next two minutes show whether Žalgiris's depth is a weapon or a dip.
items.evidence: Grenda 4/4, 8 pts in 6.3 min. Žalgiris last 3:00: 0 pts. Kretinga rim attempts 1 → 3

items.text: **Attack the rim while Grenda sits**: Urbonas and Einikis downhill, not off the catch from three.
items.evidence: Kretinga 3P 2/8; rim 1/3; Žalgiris bench five on

items.text: The story of Q1 is a Žalgiris scheme on both ends. On defence they're **packing the paint and conceding the top of the arc**: Kretinga have taken half their shots from above the break and none from the short paint, the opposite of how Žalgiris usually defend. On offence they've cut their own threes and gone to the rim, 7/8 there.
items.evidence: Kretinga above-break 3s: 50% of shots (Žalgiris usually allow 22%), paint 0%. Žalgiris rim 7/8; their own above-break 3 share 28% vs 44% usual

items.text: **Stay packed, but run them off the corner.** Concede the above-break three; Kretinga have already hit one of three from the corners, their best spot.
items.evidence: Kretinga corner 3: 48% in earlier games, 1/3 tonight; above-break 1/6

items.text: Žalgiris 24–15 after one. The gap is almost exactly **what Kretinga gave away with the ball**: five steals worth nine Žalgiris points. In the half court this is close to even. Žalgiris's rim finishing (7/8) is partly hot hands, so don't expect it to last. For Q2, watch two things: whether Kretinga can get a paint touch against the packed defence, and Bardauskas's ten-man rotation against two Kretinga starters who haven't sat yet.
items.evidence: Žalgiris after steals: 5 poss, 9 pts. Points per shot 1.26 from looks worth ~0.99. Urbonas and D. Adomaitis 10:00 straight

items.text: **Rest Urbonas for the first two minutes of Q2**, while Žalgiris's bench is on. A breather now buys you a fresh shooter in Q4.
items.evidence: Urbonas 10:00 straight, averages 39 min; Kretinga Q4 net only +3 this season

items.text: The clearest number of the night: **Žalgiris score 1.38 per trip when they run, 0.25 when Kretinga's defence is set**. Every Žalgiris point so far has come before Kretinga could match up. That is the pre-game scout exactly, and it means Kretinga's offence is also their defence: a made shot or a dead ball is worth more than it looks.
items.evidence: Žalgiris after a steal or defensive rebound: 16 poss, 1.38 pts. Against a set defence: 8 poss, 0.25

items.text: **Inbound fast after Kretinga makes.** Your half court is 2 points in 8 trips; the quick outlet is your best set.
items.evidence: 0.25 pts per possession against a set defence

items.text: Kretinga have taken the rim away. **Žalgiris's last twelve shots are mostly from outside**, after nearly two-thirds came inside early on, and they haven't scored for over three minutes. Mikaločius's five with Bruzdeilinas in place of Bružas has done it: 5–0 so far. The offensive rebounds (8 of 15) are what's still keeping Žalgiris alive.
items.evidence: Žalgiris last 12 shots 42% in the paint (64% before). Five with Bruzdeilinas: 5–0 in 11 poss. Žalgiris OREB 8/15, K. Adomaitis 3

items.text: **Hit the glass with a body, not a jump**: box out K. Adomaitis. Žalgiris's half court only scores off second chances right now.
items.evidence: Žalgiris own misses rebounded 8/15; set-defence offence 0.25 per possession

items.text: Einikis normally lives in the lane, with 60% of his shots in the paint. Tonight it's one in six. **Žalgiris's help is sitting in his driving lanes**, so he's turned into a spot-up shooter, and he's made two. That's a fine result for Kretinga today, but a fragile one: it depends on a shot he usually misses.
items.evidence: Einikis paint share 17% tonight vs 60% before; 3P 2/5 tonight, 2/16 in earlier games

items.text: **Urbonas–Einikis two-man game**: ball screen with Einikis as the screener. If they help on the roll, Urbonas has his three; if not, Einikis catches downhill.
items.evidence: Einikis shut out of the lane; Urbonas 0/2 from three, 1/4 overall

items.text: Bardauskas stops it at 26–22, after a 7–2 Kretinga quarter. His timeouts have reliably stopped runs this season. The bigger lever is personnel: **Grenda and Astrauskas, his two best starters tonight, have both sat for over five minutes** while a bench group with no half-court scoring held the floor. Kretinga's spark has been Bruzdeilinas, who has no points but helps the spacing.
items.evidence: Žalgiris timeouts this season: 25–47 in the 4 trips before, 31–33 after. Grenda last on Q1 2:xx. Bruzdeilinas on/off +54 / −58

items.text: **Grenda and Astrauskas back now.** Out of the timeout, run a ball screen for Astrauskas with Grenda rolling; Kretinga's set defence has stopped everything else.
items.evidence: Grenda 4/4 at the rim; Žalgiris 0.22 per possession against a set defence

items.text: Two opposite bets on minutes. Bardauskas came out of his timeout **still without Grenda or Astrauskas**, saving them for later at the cost of a half court that has scored 2 points in 10 set possessions. Mikaločius hasn't sat Urbonas once: 15 straight minutes, and his three turnovers are the kind tired legs make against pressure.
items.evidence: Žalgiris vs set defence: 10 poss, 0.20. Urbonas 15:06 straight, 3 TO, 2/6 FG

items.text: Called it in the preview: **the Žalgiris timeout stopped the run again**, 4–0 in the four trips after it, and Grenda is back on. It wasn't a half-court set that did it: one of the baskets came off a seventh steal. Kretinga's turnovers have now given up 11 points. That's the whole margin, plus a bit.
items.evidence: After Žalgiris timeout Q2 5:31: 4–0 over 4 trips. Steals → 11 pts in 7 poss. Score 30–22

items.text: **Give Urbonas two minutes before half-time.** 16 straight minutes, 4 turnovers; Bruzdeilinas and Goriunovas can bring it up.
items.evidence: Urbonas 16:00 straight, 4 TO; Bruzdeilinas +16 on / −58 off

items.text: Mikaločius's second timeout, and a curious choice out of it: **back to the starting five with Bružas**, the group that has been outscored 8–15 tonight, with Bruzdeilinas to the bench. The five with Bruzdeilinas is the only Kretinga group ahead. Expect Žalgiris to go straight back to pressure on the inbound.
items.evidence: Starting five: 8–15 in 23 poss tonight (−5 per 100 over 168 this season). Bruzdeilinas five: 5–2 in 11

items.text: Kretinga have changed how they attack: **half of their last twelve shots came in the paint**, after a quarter of the earlier ones. Bružas, a paint player, is 2/2, so the starting five makes more sense now that the ball is going inside rather than around the arc. Žalgiris, meanwhile, have scored two points in twelve half-court possessions all night.
items.evidence: Kretinga last 12 shots: 50% paint (25% before). Bružas 2/2. Žalgiris vs set defence: 12 poss, 0.17 pts

items.text: **Collapse on the drive again**: Kretinga have started getting into the paint. Make them beat you from the top of the arc, where they're 3/12.
items.evidence: Kretinga above-break 3P 3/12; last 12 shots 50% in the paint

items.text: Žalgiris's half-court drought is **a making problem more than a selection problem**. Their shots are worth about 0.97 points at normal accuracy and they're getting 0.74. Raulušavičius is the example: he's getting into the paint far more than usual, but 1/7. Those looks usually fall. If they start to, a seven-point lead becomes a lot more.
items.evidence: Žalgiris expected 0.97 pts/shot, actual 0.74. Raulušavičius 86% of shots in the paint (52% before), 1/7 FG

items.text: The quiet Žalgiris number of the half: **with Mackevičius at the point they score at a different level**, about 158 per 100 possessions, against 58 without him. His box line is two points; his value is pace. He's the one pushing it before Kretinga can set, which is the only offence that has worked for Žalgiris tonight.
items.evidence: Mackevičius on/off: +81 / +2 per 100; offence 158 on / 58 off (small sample, ~6 min). Žalgiris vs set defence 0.15 per possession

items.text: **Mackevičius plays more in the second half.** He's the one who gets you into the open floor before Kretinga set.
items.evidence: +81 per 100 with him on; Žalgiris 1.28 in transition, 0.15 vs set defence

items.text: Žalgiris 37–25 at the half, and the split is stark. **When Kretinga's defence is set, Žalgiris have scored 2 points in 13 trips.** Everything else came off steals, long rebounds and second chances. So Kretinga aren't being outplayed in the half court; they're being punished for what happens before it. Their own offence has been Žalgiris's gift: 3/17 from above the break, the exact shot the scheme concedes. Kretinga have won Q3 by 14 on average this season. To repeat that they need fewer turnovers, a rested Urbonas (20 straight minutes, 3 fouls), and a paint touch before every three.
items.evidence: Žalgiris: 1.35 per possession in transition (26 poss), 0.15 vs set defence (13). Kretinga: 7 steals → 11 Žalgiris pts; above-break 3P 3/17; expected 0.90 per shot, actual 0.67

items.text: **Paint touch before any three.** Your half-court defence is winning; to make it count, stop gifting transition with quick threes and loose passes.
items.evidence: Kretinga above-break 3P 3/17; Žalgiris 0.15 per possession vs your set defence

items.text: **Keep the shell, keep running.** Kretinga will try to drive in Q3: two in the lane, and outlet before they get back.
items.evidence: Kretinga in-paint shots 17% of last 12; Žalgiris 1.35 in transition

items.text: Both benches restart with their starters. Bardauskas brings back **Mackevičius at the point with Grenda and Astrauskas**, the group that set the pace in Q1. Mikaločius stays with the five that is 11–22 tonight. Its season record says it's roughly even, so this is a bet that the first half was noise. Urbonas starts having never sat.
items.evidence: Žalgiris five Adomaitis–Raulušavičius–Mackevičius–Grenda–Astrauskas: 9–5 in Q1. Kretinga starting five: 11–22 in 40 poss tonight, −5 per 100 over 168 this season

items.text: An 11–0 Žalgiris run across half-time, and this one isn't turnovers: **eight straight Kretinga misses, mostly threes**, each one a long rebound that Mackevičius runs off. The Žalgiris starting five is now 13–5 together. Kretinga haven't called a timeout, and their best shooter has been on the court for all 22 minutes and is 2/9.
items.evidence: Run Q2 1:31 → Q3 7:59: Kretinga 0 TO, 8 missed FGA. Kretinga above-break 3P 3/21. Urbonas 22:00 straight

items.text: **Timeout now, and sit Urbonas for two minutes.** Come back with the Bruzdeilinas five and a post touch for Adomaitis before any shot.
items.evidence: 11–0 run, 8 straight misses; Urbonas 22 min, 2/9; Bruzdeilinas five 5–2

items.text: Žalgiris's offence has narrowed to one player. **Raulušavičius has taken six of their last eleven shots**, and he's 3/13 tonight. Meanwhile Grenda, 4/5 and the best finisher on the floor, has one shot in Q3. With a 15-point lead it doesn't hurt yet, but it's the kind of habit that lets a cold Kretinga back in.
items.evidence: Raulušavičius 6 of last 11 Žalgiris FGA, 3/13 FG. Grenda 4/5 FG, 1 FGA this quarter

items.text: **Run something for Grenda.** Post him or roll him; he's 4/5, and the ball has been stopping with Raulušavičius.
items.evidence: Raulušavičius 6 of last 11 shots, 3/13; Grenda 4/5

items.text: Urbonas picks up his **fourth foul with 15 minutes left** and stays on. That's a defensible call from Mikaločius at 13 down, since Kretinga need his shooting to come back. The risk is that he now can't defend Žalgiris's drives without fouling out, and he has played every second. The bright spot: Kretinga are 6/8 at the rim and 4/25 everywhere else. The answer is in the paint.
items.evidence: Urbonas 4 PF, 24:36 straight. Kretinga rim 6/8, all other FG 4/30

items.text: **Hide Urbonas on the weakest Žalgiris wing** and attack the rim every trip: you're 6/8 there and 4/30 elsewhere.
items.evidence: Urbonas 4 fouls; Kretinga rim 6/8

items.text: The game has slowed down, and that suits Kretinga's defence: **Žalgiris have scored 2 points in 16 half-court possessions all night**, and three empty minutes now. Kretinga's half court has been only slightly better. The lead holds because the runs came earlier. If Kretinga keep the game at a walk and keep attacking the rim, 13 points over 14 minutes is still reachable.
items.evidence: Žalgiris vs set defence: 16 poss, 0.12 pts. Last 3 min: Kretinga 4, Žalgiris 0

items.text: **Speed it back up**: full-court pressure after made free throws and timeouts. Your half court is 2 points in 16 trips; the open floor is your offence.
items.evidence: Žalgiris 1.21 per possession in transition, 0.12 against a set defence

items.text: Bardauskas takes a timeout at 44–32, and Einikis is the reason. The pre-game bet was to go under screens and let him shoot. **He's now 3/9 from three and has 17 of Kretinga's 32 points.** One good night from a 13% shooter isn't a trend, but at this point it's a scoring source the scheme is choosing to allow. The timeout is the moment to change who guards him and how.
items.evidence: Einikis 5/13 FG, 3/9 3P, 17 pts (2/16 from three in earlier games). Kretinga last 3 min: 5–2

items.text: **Change the Einikis coverage: over the screen, hand in his face.** Make him drive into the packed paint instead.
items.evidence: Einikis 3/9 from three tonight, 17 pts

items.text: The lineup story is now clear. **With Bruzdeilinas in place of Bružas, Kretinga are 15–6; with the usual five, 13–26.** It's the spacing: one more shooter pulls a Žalgiris helper out of the paint, and Kretinga are 7/9 at the rim. That five has just cut the lead to nine, against a Žalgiris bench group that has gone cold.
items.evidence: Bruzdeilinas five: 15–6 in 25 poss. Starting five: 13–26 in 50. Kretinga 8–2 run Q3 4:03–2:30. Kretinga rim 7/9

items.text: **Keep the Bruzdeilinas five on into Q4.** It's +9 tonight while the starting five is −13. Ride it.
items.evidence: 15–6 in 25 possessions vs 13–26 in 50

items.text: **Urbonas finally sits, after 28½ straight minutes** and with four fouls: the rest I suggested at the end of Q1, arriving late. It's the right moment, though. The minute before the break plus the interval gives him about three real minutes off before a Q4 Kretinga need him for. Einikis and Goriunovas are close to 20 straight as well.
items.evidence: Urbonas 28:36 straight, 4 PF, 7 TO. Einikis 19 straight min, Goriunovas 20

items.text: Žalgiris 48–37 with ten to play. Kretinga edged Q3 12–11 after falling 17 behind, and **Mikaločius found his answer during the quarter**: the Bruzdeilinas five (+9 tonight) and drives instead of threes. Žalgiris's 11-point cushion comes from the end of the first half. For Q4, it comes down to legs and choices. Kretinga's top three have each played 20+ minutes straight. Žalgiris have rested everyone, but they need either the open floor back or Grenda touches in the half court (just 0.38 points per set possession tonight).
items.evidence: Q3: 11–12. Bruzdeilinas five 15–6 in 28 poss. Kretinga rim 7/9, above-break 3P 5/26. Žalgiris vs set defence 0.38 (21 poss), Grenda 4/5 and on the bench since Q3 6:00

items.text: **Start Q4 with Grenda and Mackevičius**, and press after every make. Fresh legs against a tired Kretinga backcourt is your edge.
items.evidence: Goriunovas 21 and Einikis 20 straight minutes; Mackevičius +65 on court

items.text: **Drive, kick, drive.** 7/9 at the rim, 5/26 from above the break. Every possession needs a paint touch before a shot.
items.evidence: Kretinga rim 7/9; above-break 3P 5/26
